description: This file defines an abstract test runner class for Orleans transactions using xUnit, providing various test methods for transactional grain operations with different configurations.

classes.name: GoldenPathTransactionTestRunnerxUnit
classes.description: An abstract class extending GoldenPathTransactionTestRunner, providing xUnit-specific test method implementations with various transaction scenarios.

methods.name: SingleGrainReadTransaction
methods.description: Overrides base method to run a single grain read transaction test with specific grain states.

methods.name: SingleGrainWriteTransaction
methods.description: Overrides base method to run a single grain write transaction test with specific grain states.

methods.name: MultiGrainWriteTransaction
methods.description: Overrides base method to run a multi-grain write transaction test with specific grain states and count.

methods.name: MultiGrainReadWriteTransaction
methods.description: Overrides base method to run a multi-grain read/write transaction test with specific grain states and count.

methods.name: RepeatGrainReadWriteTransaction
methods.description: Overrides base method to run repeated grain read/write transaction tests with specific grain states and count.

methods.name: MultiWriteToSingleGrainTransaction
methods.description: Overrides base method to test multiple writes to a single grain with specific grain states.

methods.name: RWRWTest
methods.description: Overrides base method to perform a read-write/read-write transaction test with specific grain states and count.

methods.name: WRWRTest
methods.description: Overrides base method to perform a write-read/write-read transaction test with specific grain states and count.
